benchmark: Jazzy/Kallisto EEQ hydration free energy on FreeSolv 642
interpretation_warning: The strict_identifier_non_overlap group is non-overlapping only relative to the official Jazzy Gerber curated training file and the recorded molecular identity rules. It is not claimed to be an independently curated test set.

identity_policy.confirmed_exact_overlap: Canonical isomeric SMILES OR full standard InChIKey matches a Gerber curated training row.
identity_policy.connectivity_only_possible_overlap: No exact match, but canonical non-isomeric SMILES OR the first InChIKey connectivity block matches. These records are excluded from strict non-overlap.
identity_policy.strict_identifier_non_overlap: No match by any of the four recorded exact/connectivity identifiers.
identity_policy.reported_overlap_group: Union of confirmed exact and connectivity-only possible overlap.

known_deviations_from_declared_dependenc: Jazzy 0.1.4 declares rdkit==2024.3.1; this smoke environment uses rdkit 2024.9.2.
Kallisto 1.0.10 declares numpy<2; this smoke environment uses numpy 2.3.5.
The temporary virtual environment reuses system-site packages and is not a clean locked installation.

calculation.geometry: FreeSolv GAFF MOL2 coordinates and bonds read by MAPLE MOL2Reader, then converted directly to an explicit-H RDKit molecule; no embedding or minimization.
